title: 第120章 门口那个孩子
slug: 我一值夜班全院主任都睡不着
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

急诊门口的自动门刚滑开一半，雨水味先卷进来，后面才是衣服上沾着的烧烤油烟。

平车轮子磕过门槛，夜班护士小郑一只手扶着床栏，一只手去接孩子父亲怀里的孩子。保安站在旁边，制服袖口沾了一点呕吐物。

孩子七八岁，身上的短袖前襟蹭着孜然粉，裤脚沾了雨后的泥点。人软塌塌地歪在父亲怀里，嘴唇颜色发灰，像冻过一样。

“医生，医生你快看看，他刚才还会说话，路上突然就不吭声了。”

男人的车钥匙还攥在手里，钥匙齿在掌心压出几道红印。他鞋带没系，后脚跟踩着鞋帮，跟着平车一路往里跑。

孙志强已经到了门口。

“放平车上，头偏一边。小郑，吸引器推过来，氧气接上。”

林野托住孩子肩膀，把他侧过一点。呕吐物又从嘴角淌出来一小口，小郑立刻把吸引管递过来。

“小朋友，听得到吗？”

孩子没有睁眼，只从喉咙里发出一点含糊的气声。

孙志强手背贴了一下孩子颈侧，又看向林野。

“报情况。”

林野的指腹按在孩子脉搏上。

心跳快。

皮肤不算烫。

可那种灰紫色，不像单纯吐脱了水。

“意识差，呼叫反应弱。刚吐过，先防误吸。脉搏快，嘴唇发灰，要先测血糖、血压、血氧，接监护。”

“先上监护，血糖先测。”

孙志强话音刚落，平车已经被推进红区门口。

宋广福那边，心内科值班医生还守在床旁补医嘱，听见动静只是抬头看了一眼，很快又低下头核对胸痛流程用药。

“四床我接着，你们忙门口那个。”

赵护士没离红区太远，宋广福那边由心内科值班医生压着病历夹接住。她从治疗车最上层抽出一只备用面罩，往经过的小郑手里一塞，又冲孩子父亲摆手。

“孩子爸爸，站床尾这边，别趴孩子身上。你挡着医生手了。”

男人硬生生停住，整个人贴在床尾，声音发紧。

“是不是吃坏了？夜市那边好几个人都吐了。他就吃了两串鸡翅，一杯冰粉，还夹了一点凉拌牛肉。我就说不该让他乱吃。”

分诊台那边，护士还在追刚才那通预报。

“旁边有炭火炉吗？发电机在棚子里吗？棚子封不封？”

林野刚想问吃了什么，视野边缘忽然亮了一下。

淡蓝色提示框在他视野边缘跳出来。

【急诊预警：急性高铁血红蛋白血症风险上升。】

【可能来源：亚硝酸盐相关食物中毒。】

【易误判点：普通食物中毒、肺部缺氧、哮喘发作。】

【关键异常：发绀明显，吸氧后血氧不升，血气氧分压可能不低。】

林野握着床栏的手紧了一下，视线从氧气面罩挪到治疗车上的采血管。

刚才那通120预报，让分诊先追棚子、炭火和发电机。

可眼前这个孩子的颜色不对。

血也得先看。

他没有看任何人，直接转向孩子父亲。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The automatic door at the emergency room door had just slid open halfway, and the smell of rain rolled in first, followed by the barbecue fumes stained on the clothes.

The wheels of the flatbed wheel bumped across the threshold. Xiao Zheng, the night shift nurse, held on to the bed rail with one hand and went to pick up the child from his father's arms with the other.The security guard stood nearby, his uniform sleeves stained with vomit.

The child is seven or eight years old. The front of his short-sleeved shirt is stained with cumin powder, and the legs of his trousers are stained with mud from the rain.He was lying limply in his father's arms, his lips were gray, as if he had been frozen.

"Doctor, doctor, look quickly. He was still talking just now, but suddenly he stopped talking on the road."

The man's car key was still clutched in his hand, and the key teeth made several red marks on his palm.His shoelaces were untied, and he stepped on the upper of the shoe with his back heel as he followed the flat car all the way in.

Sun Zhiqiang has already arrived at the door.

"Left the car flat and tilt your head to one side. Xiao Zheng, push the suction device over and connect the oxygen."

Lin Ye held the child's shoulders and turned him a little sideways.Another small mouthful of vomit trickled out from the corner of his mouth, and Xiao Zheng immediately handed over the suction tube.

"Kid, can you hear me?"

The child did not open his eyes and only made a vague sound from his throat.

Sun Zhiqiang put the back of his hand against the side of the child's neck and looked at Lin Ye again.

"Report the situation."

Lin Ye pressed his fingertips on the child's pulse.

Rapid heartbeat.

The skin is not too hot.

But that kind of gray-purple color doesn't look like just vomiting water.

"Poor consciousness, weak call response. Just vomited, first prevent aspiration. Pulse is fast, lips are gray, blood sugar, blood pressure, blood oxygen should be measured first, and monitored."

"Go to monitoring first, and test your blood sugar first."

As soon as Sun Zhiqiang finished speaking, the flat car was already pushed into the entrance of the red zone.

At Song Guangfu's side, the doctor on duty in the cardiology department was still standing by the bedside to fill in the medical orders. He just raised his head when he heard the movement, and then quickly lowered his head to check the medication for chest pain.

"I'll take over the fourth bed. You guys are busy with the one at the door."

Nurse Zhao was not too far away from the red zone, and the doctor on duty at the cardiology department held Song Guangfu's hand holding the medical record folder to catch her.She pulled out a spare mask from the top of the treatment cart, stuffed it into Xiao Zheng's hand as he passed by, and waved to the child's father.

"Dad, stand at the end of the bed and don't lie on top of the child. You are blocking the doctor's hands."

The man stopped abruptly and leaned against the end of the bed, his voice tight.

"Did he eat something bad? Several people at the night market vomited. He just ate two skewers of chicken wings, a cup of ice powder, and some cold beef. I told him that he shouldn't be allowed to eat randomly."

Over at the triage table, the nurse was still catching up on the forecast just now.

"Is there a charcoal stove nearby? Is the generator in the shed? Is the shed sealed?"

Just as Lin Ye was about to ask what he had eaten, the edge of his vision suddenly lit up.

A light blue prompt box popped up at the edge of his field of vision.

[Emergency warning: The risk of acute methemoglobinemia increases.】

[Possible source: nitrite-related food poisoning.】

[Points of easy misjudgment: common food poisoning, lung hypoxia, asthma attack.】

[Key abnormality: cyanosis is obvious, blood oxygen does not rise after inhaling oxygen, and blood gas oxygen partial pressure may not be low.】

Lin Ye's hand on the bed rail tightened, and his eyes moved from the oxygen mask to the blood collection tubes on the treatment cart.

The 120 forecast just now told the triage team to first look for sheds, charcoal fires and generators.

But the color of the child in front of me is wrong.

The blood also needs to be seen first.

Without looking at anyone, he turned directly to the child's father.
